source_basis: V3 development trace: preserve actual source refs through extraction, computation and final submission. No target answers or task IDs.

skill.title: OA-Target
skill.goal: OA-Target: Interpret the exact requested quantity before choosing a formula
skill.guidance: Identify the requested quantity, scope, period, units, formula and output precision from the question. Use supplied pages first. Missing evidence remains missing; never invent a value or use an expected answer to choose a formula.

skill.title: OA-Locate
skill.goal: OA-Locate: Read the supplied page titles, table captions, headers and relevant rows first
skill.guidance: Search a specific missing fact in candidate files. A grep hit is a location: read its body; rereading hits is not reading the table. scoped_search batches search and reading. read_context before+after <=12000 Unicode characters. Change the source/issue for a missing period; avoid overlapping rereads.

skill.title: OA-Table
skill.goal: OA-Table: Match the full hierarchy of a column header, not just a repeated word such as Total
skill.guidance: For a complete numeric calculation with unambiguous rows, prefer table_calculate. It reads real source_ref text, extracts cells, computes and submits without a model rewrite. tables: key, source_ref, ordered rows, exact column, quoted unit, optional header_hint/offset/length. bindings maps operand fields to ordered table keys, e.g. numerator:[a],denominator:[b], or values:[series]. calculation selects method, operation, decimals and named options. submit_answer=true declares the full task calculation. needs_input requires correcting the reported evidence gap. Missing year labels, shifted cells and duplicate rows require a clearer source, never guessed mapping. Use intermediate Programs when this is only a partial calculation.

skill.title: OA-Units
skill.goal: OA-Units: Carry the source unit with each operand
skill.guidance: Bind the full header and unit: total/component, nominal/real, fiscal/calendar, thousands/millions and currency direction. Preserve signs, decimals and footnotes; blank/dash is not zero. No implicit unit conversion in table_calculate. treasury_transform handles explicit scale, currency and quote conventions.

skill.title: OA-Stats
skill.goal: OA-Stats: Select the formula from the wording before calling a calculator
skill.guidance: Choose the defined denominator. Difference=new-old; relative change=(new-base)/base; symmetric difference=abs(new-old)/((abs(old)+abs(new))/2); share difference=part2/total2-part1/total1. Percent/percentage points multiply by 100. Annual log growth=ln(new/base)/elapsed_intervals; CAGR=exp(ln(new/base)/elapsed_intervals)-1. Population variance uses n, sample n-1. Use named series_metrics operations; table_calculate also supports absolute_relative_change. Never mix totals/components or round before the last step. Execute long-series calculations before finish-only.

skill.title: OA-Commit
skill.goal: OA-Commit: When the question is answered by supported operands and the intended calculation, use the native runtime_step finish action immediately
skill.guidance: Submit the supported requested result immediately. Successful table_calculate uses the existing final-answer path; there is no extra LLM rewrite. Otherwise finish with the computed answer unchanged, under the shared output contract. No compulsory verification call.

skill.title: OA-Fallback
skill.goal: OA-Fallback: Use the smallest execution path that resolves the task
skill.guidance: All seven Programs remain callable. Prefer source-bound table_calculate for full-task arithmetic. Otherwise use an intermediate Program or temporary top-level Python with existing ctx, no inputs/run wrapper/ctx reassignment. ctx.call shares the budget. Check accepted and documented paths; return compact JSON. No repeated invalid calls.

skill.title: OA-Periods
skill.goal: OA-Periods: List the required observations and their exact time basis before computing a series statistic
skill.guidance: Enumerate requested periods and fiscal/calendar basis; inclusive observations differ from elapsed intervals. No omitted periods, duplicate vintages or interpolation. Forecast error needs an independently published target actual. An issue may lag observations: retrieve that actual from a later issue instead of substituting the last fitting value.

skill.title: OA-Fiscal
skill.goal: OA-Fiscal: Use the table's period labels to distinguish fiscal years, calendar years, monthly totals and year-to-date amounts
skill.guidance: Keep fiscal and calendar totals separate. A fiscal year is not automatically January through December; follow the source period definition and any transition quarter. Compare flows over matching intervals and stocks at matching dates.

skill.title: OA-Treasury
skill.goal: OA-Treasury: Read Treasury categories literally: issued, retired, redeemed, tenders received, tenders accepted, public debt outstanding, net cash raised, refunding, public holdings and government accounts describe different quantities
skill.guidance: Distinguish debt outstanding, issuance/redemption flows, holdings and net changes; retain marketable/nonmarketable and investor categories. Treasury price ticks, fine/troy weights and exchange-rate direction need explicit source conventions. Do not infer the target from a nearby similar total.

skill.title: OA-Advanced
skill.goal: OA-Advanced: For correlation and OLS, align x and y by identical observation periods and specify dependent versus independent variable; slope changes if they are reversed
skill.guidance: Polynomial OLS: table_calculate bindings observations:[series], actual:[target]; calculation method=polynomial_forecast, operation=predict|absolute_error, degree, first_x, x_step, prediction_x, decimals. It uses an intercept and exact coverage checks; labels and source unit must be consistent. For other models preserve specified order, intercept and horizon. NumPy is available; scipy/statsmodels are not installed. Never silently substitute a different model.

skill.title: OA-Revision
skill.goal: OA-Revision: Treat publication vintage as part of a value's identity when the question names a report, issue, as-of date, preliminary or revised basis
skill.guidance: Respect requested publication vintage and as-of date. Later revisions may differ from originally reported values; select the specified vintage, not the value that seems most plausible. Preserve preliminary/adjusted status and footnotes.

program.title: Polynomial OLS forecast or absolute prediction error; explicit period coverage and source operands
program.source:
"""Polynomial OLS over explicit public observations; no implicit imputation.

Inputs are public, explicitly aligned observations. This computes a polynomial
OLS forecast with an intercept; it cannot certify source/column semantics.
"""
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext, ROUND_HALF_UP


def run(ctx, inputs):
    try:
        degree = inputs['degree']
        if type(degree) is not int or not 1 <= degree <= 5:
            raise ValueError('degree must be 1..5')
        rows = inputs['observations']
        expected = inputs['required_periods']
        if not degree < len(expected) <= 240 or len(set(expected)) != len(expected):
            raise ValueError('distinct required periods and at least degree+1 observations required')
        if len(rows) != len(expected) or [r['period'] for r in rows] != expected:
            raise ValueError('observations must cover every required period once, in specified order')
        if any(r['unit'] != inputs['unit'] or not r.get('source_ref') for r in rows):
            raise ValueError('consistent units and source references required')
        operation = inputs['operation']
        if operation not in ('predict', 'absolute_error'):
            raise ValueError('choose predict or absolute_error')
        actual = inputs.get('actual')
        if operation == 'absolute_error' and actual is None:
            raise ValueError('absolute_error requires an independently acquired actual value')
        if actual is not None and (actual['unit'] != inputs['unit'] or not actual.get('source_ref')):
            raise ValueError('actual value needs matching units and a source reference')
        digits = inputs['decimals']
        if type(digits) is not int or not 0 <= digits <= 18:
            raise ValueError('decimals must be 0..18')
        with localcontext() as context:
            context.prec = 60
            x = [Decimal(str(r['x'])) for r in rows]
            y = [Decimal(str(r['value'])) for r in rows]
            target = Decimal(str(inputs['prediction_x']))
            observed = Decimal(str(actual['value'])) if actual is not None else None
            if not all(v.is_finite() for v in x+y+[target]+([] if observed is None else [observed])):
                raise ValueError('finite numeric values required')
            if len(set(x)) < degree+1:
                raise ValueError('rank deficient design')
            center = sum(x)/len(x)
            scale = max(abs(v-center) for v in x)
            z = [(v-center)/scale for v in x]
            design = [[Decimal(1)]+[v**j for j in range(1, degree+1)] for v in z]
            width = degree+1
            matrix = [[sum(r[i]*r[j] for r in design) for j in range(width)]
                      +[sum(r[i]*v for r, v in zip(design, y))] for i in range(width)]
            for i in range(width):
                pivot = max(range(i, width), key=lambda j: abs(matrix[j][i]))
                matrix[i], matrix[pivot] = matrix[pivot], matrix[i]
                divisor = matrix[i][i]
                if divisor == 0:
                    raise ValueError('rank deficient design')
                matrix[i] = [v/divisor for v in matrix[i]]
                for j in range(width):
                    if j != i:
                        factor = matrix[j][i]
                        matrix[j] = [a-factor*b for a, b in zip(matrix[j], matrix[i])]
            coefficients = [r[-1] for r in matrix]
            target_z = (target-center)/scale
            prediction = coefficients[-1]
            for c in reversed(coefficients[:-1]):
                prediction = prediction*target_z+c
            error = abs(prediction-observed) if observed is not None else None
            value = prediction if operation == 'predict' else error
            answer = format(value.quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-digits), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), f'.{digits}f')
            return {'status': 'ok', 'outputs': {
                'count': len(rows), 'degree': degree, 'unit': inputs['unit'],
                'center': str(center), 'scale': str(scale),
                'coefficient_basis': 'ascending powers of (x-center)/scale, including intercept',
                'coefficients': [str(v) for v in coefficients],
                'prediction': str(prediction), 'actual': str(observed) if observed is not None else None,
                'absolute_difference': str(error) if error is not None else None, 'answer': answer,
                'formula': 'unweighted polynomial OLS with intercept; '+('prediction' if operation == 'predict' else 'abs(prediction-actual)'),
                'proof_scope': 'calculation and explicit coverage only; source semantics not certified'}}
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, ArithmeticError) as exc:
        return {'status': 'needs_input', 'outputs': {}, 'detail': str(exc)}
